---
title: "F-fsAEAD — Forward-secure AEAD"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 2
---

*F-fsAEAD* (Forward-secure AEAD) is part of *Cryptographic Library and Symmetric Primitives* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

Introduced as one piece of a decomposition of the Signal protocol, alongside *F-secmsg* and *F-CKE*.

*References:*

- Canetti et al. [*Universally composable end-to-end secure messaging*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2022/376). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2022, volume 13508 of LNCS, 2022.
